value.rationale: A single Hamming shell is a canonical sampling domain for low-degree Walsh functions. The theorem gives all concentration eigenvalues, the exact universal \(n+1\)-dimensional low-band kernel, and the complete exceptional spectral degeneracies. The infinite arithmetic resonance \(n=r^2+1\) identifies precisely when two distinct harmonic sectors become spectrally indistinguishable; this informs exact conditioning and interpolation on constant-weight data and is more than a restatement of Johnson diagonalization. No claim is made for larger bands.
